explain.activity: For each form: how many were due till today (EC), how many were filled (AC) and how many were left incomplete (IC). A green bar as long as the grey one means all due forms were filled.
explain.outcomes: The baby's growth against the WHO standard at the first (BV), middle (AV) and latest (LV) visit. Bars to the left of 0 are below the standard; below −2 needs attention.
